title: MxAgile Harness Adapter Contract
description: Smallest generic adapter contract for external harness, gateway, or provider integration with MxAgile Context Lifecycle. Harness-agnostic: not tied to any specific AI provider. The adapter supplies capability and measurement data when actually available; absent fields are treated as UNKNOWN. No hosted service required. No external network services required. See docs/context-lifecycle.md and .mxagile/policies/context-lifecycle.md.

adapter_version.description: Adapter contract version for forward-compatibility detection.

model_capability.description: Physical model capability. Supplied by harness when known.

context_measurement.description: Observed context-token usage. Supplied when a reliable measurement exists.

harness_capability.description: What the harness can do for context lifecycle management.

transition_result.description: Result of the most recent session/epoch transition attempt, if any.

model_capability.description: Physical model identity and capability. Values here are factual properties of the model, not policy decisions.

model_id.description: Model identifier as reported by harness or gateway (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gpt-4o'). Used for profile lookup in model-profiles.yaml.

context_window_tokens.description: Physical context-window size in tokens. Overrides model-profiles.yaml when supplied by harness.

source.description: How this capability information was obtained.

context_measurement.description: Observed context-token usage at a point in time. Do not fabricate measurements locally. Accept only from harness, gateway, or explicit user input.

estimated_context_tokens.description: Current context size in tokens as measured or reported.

source.description: How this measurement was obtained. 'unknown' means no reliable measurement.

reliability.description: Reliability classification of the measurement. 'exact': authoritative count from gateway. 'estimate': approximate (e.g. local tokenizer). 'stale': measurement is from a prior request cycle. 'unknown': reliability cannot be determined.

measured_at.description: ISO datetime or sequence number when this measurement was taken.

harness_capability.description: Capabilities the harness provides for context lifecycle management.

can_report_tokens.description: True if the harness can supply context_measurement. False or absent: token reporting unavailable.

can_start_fresh_context.description: True if the harness can programmatically start a fresh agent context (new session/epoch). Required for automatic rollover.

can_pass_resume_path.description: True if the harness can pass the checkpoint file path to a new session at startup.

supports_epoch_transition.description: True if the harness supports the full epoch transition protocol (checkpoint + fresh context + resume). When false, rollover produces a deterministic rollover-ready state but cannot execute the transition.

transition_result.description: Result of the most recent session/epoch transition, if the harness attempted one.

attempted.description: True if a transition was attempted.

succeeded.description: True if the transition completed successfully.

new_session_id.description: Identifier of the new session, if the harness provides one.

checkpoint_path.description: Path to the checkpoint file used for the transition.

failure_reason.description: Why the transition failed, if it did.
